messages:
jess: quick sync on pool picker flyout + SLO presets. dropped updated frames + a short screencap: https://figma.com/file/abc

anya: watched the clip. main ask: reduce clicks to select the common pools. the current long list forces too much scanning.

sam: idea: show a compact horizontal "quick pick" row at the top of the flyout with 3 most-used + user-pinned pools. then keep the full list scrollable below.

mike: backend note: we can return a "preferredPools" array per org and a separate full list. small API change but stable. ok from infra side.

jess: love that. microcopy: the quick picks should include a tiny metric line like "~99ms" and a chevron icon to open full details. keep it visually minimal.

omar: Accessibility: those metric lines must not be the sole carrier of meaning. add visually-hidden text like "recommended: low-latency, SLO 99ms" for screen readers. Also ensure the quick pick buttons have 44px tap target.

lee: copy debate: currently using label "Burst" in the header chip. customers read it as an additional charge. propose changing to "Burst capacity" + help icon linking to billing doc.

khalid: agree. also recommend in the help panel we put a short sentence: "Burst capacity is time-limited and billed at standard rates; see pricing for details." Provide a keyboard-focusable link.

jess: can we make the billing copy even shorter for small viewport? maybe: "Burst (time-limited). Billing: standard rates." full link in flyout.

anya: yes. also UX: when a user hovers a pool in the full list, show a flyout panel on the right with 3 quick facts: SLO tier, typical throughput, and an estimated cost bucket (Low/Medium/High). Avoid %s.

mike: cost buckets only, agreed. we should surface telemetry name for click events: `ui.pool.flyout.open` and `ui.pool.quickpick.select` so analytics team can validate.

omar: color contrast: current SLO pill has 3:1 contrast in mock which fails AA. Use token `bg-surface-strong` + `text-on-strong` or outline with 4.5:1. I'll attach token suggestions in Figma.

jess: keyboard flow: enter to open flyout, arrow keys to move between quick picks, space/enter to select. for the SLO slider we need a numeric stepper fallback (up/down arrow) that announces the preset name and cost bucket via `aria-live` when changed.

khalid: implement aria-live region with polite announcements. example text: "Latency target: Balanced. Estimated cost: Medium." Keep announcements under 60 chars.

sam: what about min/max labels? current label shorthand is confusing in compact mode. change to `Min active GPUs` / `Max active GPUs` inline and show a small help link: "Why min/max?" expanding to one sentence.

jess: that aligns with the accessibility notes. also update programmatic association: `label` + `aria-labelledby` on the stepper inputs.

anya: edge case: pools with low capacity caps. if user sets Min > poolMax, show inline validation: red border + message "Requested min exceeds pool capacity; set to pool max (4)." For screen readers, announce the clamp: "Min adjusted to pool max: 4."

mike: backend limitation: some pools only expose capacity cap via a separate endpoint; we should cache caps in the client for 2 minutes to avoid extra calls. i'll draft constraints and return here.

jess: one more layout ask: compact mode (narrow screens) should collapse quick picks into a row of icons only, with tooltip text on long-press / focus. ensure focus visible ring is not removed.

omar: important: don't use hover-only tooltips for essential info. all tooltips must have keyboard equivalents and be reachable by focus. aria-describedby referencing the tooltip id works.

aria-bot: (deploy-bot) Figma updated with tokens and accessibility notes: https://figma.com/file/abc?rev=4

lee: timeline: jess to push revised frames today, mike to verify API response change, omar & khalid will review accessibility tokens and announcements. i'll draft release blurb for the console changes including the billing link.

sam: QA checklist idea: include keyboard-only flows, screen reader walkthrough, and pool-cap clamp scenarios. I'll add to the ticket.

jess: thanks all — will post frames when done :sparkles:

anya: great discussion. i'll open a tiny rollout flag PR and add canary notes. thanks!
